title: FuboTV: It's Just FuboTV
logline: A FuboTV hockey player skates toward the camera, delivers a deal line, and finishes with a hard stop that sprays ice before skating away.

cast.descriptor: a man in his late twenties, athletic build, light skin, short brown hair, wearing a reddish-orange and white hockey jersey with a large FuboTV logo on the chest, white pants, black skates, and a white helmet with a clear visor

locations.setting: The setting is a modern indoor hockey arena, with a white ice rink, reddish-orange boards, and bright overhead lights reflecting off the glossy surface.

beats.action: The FuboTV player skates forward toward the camera, stops abruptly in a hockey stop that sprays ice mist into the air, then skates away from the camera.
beats.speaker: c1
